newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse little changed in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse little changed in thin trading.

text.p: The Mauritian bourse share index Semdex eased by 0.44 points to 320.56 during a thinly traded session on Wednesday with volume concentrated in hotel stock New Mauritius Hotels, brokers said.
Volume totalled 9.62 million rupees on 367,956 shares from 4.61 million rupees on 177,231 shares on Monday.
The Mauritian bourse official market trades on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. Brokers said around 75 percent of deals on Wednesday were in New Mauritius Hotels shares.
"Owing to the relatively high volume, it looks like foreign investors again bought stocks of the hotel giant. Apart from this, trading in the rest of the market remained thin," one dealer said.
The broker said Semdex lost ground because of falling share prices of heavyweights Mauritius Commercial Bank and national carrier Air Mauritius.
MCB lost 50 cents to 72.50 rupees on 249 shares and Air Mauritius was 50 cents down to 50 rupees on 13,637 shares.
Most other shares again ended flat.

State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 8.50 rupees on 45,200 shares. Mauritius Oil Refineries gained 10 cents to 8.40 rupees on 1,700 shares while building blocks maker Gamma Civic remained at 17 rupees on 2,000 shares.

Investment stock Policy was stable at 3.50 rupees on 14,500 shares and United Docks was unchanged at 39.80 rupees on 1,530 shares. Fincorp Investment remained at 72 rupees on 441 shares and National Investment Trust lost 30 cents to 11.50 rupees on 1,850 shares.
Sugar stock Mon Desert Alma (ordinary) was stable at 79 rupees on 687 shares while Mon Desert Mon Tresor was unchanged at 35.10 rupees on 350 shares.
Conglomerate Ireland Blyth gained 10 cents to 13 rupees on 10,900 shares while Rogers remained unchanged at 89 rupees on 9,266 shares.
Happy World Foods was unchanged at 14 rupees on 5,537 shares and Sun Resorts was stable at 36 rupees on 4,136 shares.
